name: Old Wenna Hollis
role: Keeper of the Vent Games' slate 1452–1480
voice: Thin, dry and exact; calls people by their mother's name; taps her cane once for yes, twice for no.
backstory: Rosa's mother kept the slate through the Night of Cinders and most of the Ash Reign until the steam took her eyes. She sits by the Third Vent in damp towels with a cup of cider and remembers every bout since the Wet Games.

relationships.name: Gorm Halfhand
